snippet.title: Hold My Cargo — Official Trailer | Free Solo Demo Out Now
snippet.description:
Play the free single-player demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4341570/Hold_My_Cargo/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=hold_my_cargo_nextfest_2026_10&utm_content=trailer48_v3

Carry every crate. Hide the contraband. Face customs.

Hold My Cargo is a first-person space-smuggling sim. Carry cargo by hand, hide contraband aboard your ship, and choose whether to declare, bluff or bribe when customs boards.

The free solo demo is available now for Steam Next Fest. The full game is coming soon to PC on Steam.
Steam link on our channel profile.

Favera Studio: https://favera.studio/
Press kit — facts, screenshots, artwork and trailer: https://favera.studio/press/

#HoldMyCargo #SteamNextFest #IndieGame
